summary: netapp.cloudmanager is unmaintained and will be removed from Ansible 15 unless a maintainer steps up, though it can still be installed afterward.
questions: Is netapp.cloudmanager being removed from Ansible?

answer_card.title: netapp.cloudmanager to be removed
answer_card.answer_md: `netapp.cloudmanager` is considered unmaintained and will be **removed from Ansible 15** unless someone starts maintaining it. After removal: `ansible-galaxy collection install netapp.cloudmanager`.
